Salt and Pine by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Sure, Salt and Pine gets the little things right, but the big things too. This single-level home welcomes you with soaring 15-foot ceilings, inviting living spaces, and a cozy fireplace that quickly becomes the evening gathering spot. Start the morning on the front porch with coffee, then grab one of the complimentary bikes, or the six-seater golf cart, and cruise to the community's spectacular infinity pool. Or the beach! The kitchen sits at the center of it all, connected to the dining area and comfortable living room so nobody misses the conversation. The dining table seats four, with four more spots at the kitchen counter for breakfast, snacks, or whoever claims the best seat first.

When it's time to unwind, gather around the fireplace and sink into the living room's plush seating with a board game, puzzle, or simply a little extra time together. Designed for a great night's sleep, each bedroom feels like a personal hideaway, complete with blackout curtains. The primary suite features a king bed, double vanity, and walk-in shower. Two Jack-and-Jill guest rooms share a bathroom, one with a king bed, the other with two twin beds, making it easy for families to spread out without feeling spread apart. Salt and Pine sits in a quiet community just minutes from the white sand and turquoise water, with easy access to an infinity pool, fitness center, and a neighborhood pond. There’s parking for two vehicles, plus additional first-come, first-served neighborhood parking. This is a gorgeous and comfy home base with plenty to do nearby, and just enough charm to start talking about your next visit, well before this one ends. At Oversee 30A, we're local, nearby, and ready to help. Our office is open seven days a week, and our team is backed by 24/7 support, so you can spend more time enjoying your vacation and less time thinking about the details. Overview: - 1.6 miles to beach (Dune Allen Beach Access) - 6-seater golf cart included - 4 bikes included - Community infinity pool, fitness center, and pond access - Includes 6 beach chairs, 1 umbrella plus beach toys - 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths - Gas grill - Board games and puzzles - In-unit washer and dryer - Wifi Overnight: SINGLE LEVEL - Primary Bedroom: king bed, private bathroom, shower only, double vanity, TV - Guest Room: king bed, jack and jill bathroom, shower only, TV - Guest Room: two twins, jack and jill bathroom, shower only, TV - Half Bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Check-out is 10:00 AM CST
